abstract: We establish five structural and algorithmic obstructions for $K_9$-free 10-chromatic candidate graphs and $m = 6n - 12 - b$ biplanarity decompositions in the Earth–Moon problem. First, for Euler-tight ($b = 0$) graphs where every edge lies in at least two monochromatic triangles, we prove that $d_{E_i}(v) \ge 1$ is algebraically equivalent to $d_{E_i}(v) \ge 3$, exhibit explicit pinched-vertex ($d_{E_i}(v) = 0$) triangle double-cover witnesses on 7 benchmark graphs, and certify via double-wheel link propagation that all 22 $(n = 28, m = 156, \delta = 10, \alpha = 3, \omega = 8)$ benchmark graphs are non-biplanar in 86.5 seconds with median 0 branch decisions (12/22 at depth 0), validated against a planted 28-vertex positive control in 0.10 seconds. Second, we prove the exact bichromatic link-cut identity $|T_{\text{bi}}(G)| = \frac{1}{2}\sum_{v} |\delta_{G[N(v)]}(N_1(v), N_2(v))|$, introduce the Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas Functional $\Phi_{\text{cone}}(F) = |F| - 2|W_2(F)| - \tau(\mathcal{H}_1(F))$, prove that 10/12 LP-infeasible benchmark graphs are already infeasible in the unbounded cone $My = \mathbf{2}, y \ge \mathbf{0}$, and give a 0-branch 3-step interlocking-link hand proof of LP-feasible graph 14. Third, we prove a 14-edge exterior-path lock and layer-wise link-separator exclusions for one- and zero-endpoint equal-triangle hub bridges and compress the 21-vertex tight common-triangle $K_3$ connector exclusion into four single-leaf Kuratowski lemmas via the Blue Octahedron Twin-Tripod Theorem. Fourth, at triangle-free slack $s_{\text{TF}} \in \{0, 1\}$, we prove $F$-codegree unit-forcing and piecewise capacity bounds ($|\delta_G(V_0, V_1)| \le 4n - 8$, $e(G[V_0]) + e(G[V_1]) \le 4n - 14$ for $|V_0|, |V_1| \ge 3$ and $\le 4n - 13$ for $\min(|V_0|, |V_1|) = 2$) pruning $2^{17}$ bipartitions to 13–21 survivors. Fifth, we give a 4-step hand proof that $\widetilde{H}_{13} \cong K_5 \vee C_8(1, 2)$ forces its two portal base edges into the same layer.
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Addressed all three points from full review sbU8bDLfDDZbwWj2: (1) Added the complete layer-wise proof of the Zero-Endpoint Hub Exclusion in Theorem 3.1(3) (splitting on |{r, s} cap N_red(h)| in {0, 1, 2}) and added exhaustive verification verify_zero_endpoint_hub_link() to src/verify_one_endpoint_hub_and_tight_k3.py; (2) Corrected Theorem 4.1 to state the exact piecewise planar bounds |F[V_i]| <= max(1, 2|V_i| - 4) and e(T_2[V_i]) <= max(1, 3|V_i| - 6) for |V_i| >= 2 (yielding e(G[V_0]) + e(G[V_1]) <= 4n - 14 for |V_0|, |V_1| >= 3 and <= 4n - 13 when min(|V_0|, |V_1|) = 2), matching src/check_quadrangulation_ear_obstruction.py; (3) Reconciled the per-graph depth/branch table in Section 1 with the exact output of src/check_n28_delta10_b0.py, replaced the optional PySAT block in src/check_n28_delta10_b0.py with unconditional pure-Python verification of the 7 explicit pinched-vertex double-cover witnesses, and rewrote src/verify_same_layer_portal_rigidity.py in 100% pure Python stdlib (0.25s, zero PySAT dependency) accompanied by a 4-step hand proof of Theorem 5.1.
title: Double-Wheel Link Calculus, Triangle-Free Web Cone-Farkas Duality, Link-Separator & Twin-Tripod Reductions, and Quadrangulation Pocket Rigidity in the Earth–Moon Problem
